metadata.description: Claude Code plugins by Mason Flint: session pins, a spend-budget statusline, and more to come.

plugins.name: budget-statusline
plugins.description: Daily and monthly spend budget bars from the same numbers the /usage page shows, with a configurable work week and holiday calendar. For organization and Team plans with spend billing.

plugins.name: pins
plugins.description: Pin Claude Code sessions and resume them by name: a `pin` terminal picker (fzf) plus /pins:pin and /pins:unpin. Sessions found without remembering a UUID or the directory they were launched from.
